# 1 Clement Chapter 32 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 32 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_032_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 32

**32:1** If anyone will examine each of these things carefully, he will understand the greatness of the gifts given by him.

**32:2** For from Jacob come all the priests and Levites who minister at the altar of God; from him comes the Lord Jesus according to the flesh; from him come the kings and rulers and governors of Judah; and the rest of his tribes are in no small honor, as God promised: "Your seed shall be as the stars of heaven."

**32:3** All these therefore were glorified and made great, not through themselves or their own works or the righteous deeds which they accomplished, but through his will.

**32:4** And so we too, who have been called by his will in Christ Jesus, are not justified through ourselves, nor through our own wisdom or understanding or godliness or works which we have done in holiness of heart, but through faith, through which the Almighty God has justified all who have been from the beginning; to whom be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.

---

*EMET renders with maximal literalness. The remarkable proto-Pauline statement in v. 4 — justification through faith, not works — echoes Romans 3-4 and anticipates the Reformation sola fide doctrine. This is one of the most theologically significant verses in 1 Clement.*
